title: Money and serenading with white patrons
summary: He explains serenading pay: sometimes paid, sometimes food and drink from white people who took them out until daylight.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: When he was out serenading, how much money would he make?

So when he was out serenading, how much money would you make? Well, sometimes they would pay us, you see. And sometimes we would pay for white people in the country when they knock off, to take us up and keep us out to daylight. Sometimes they would give us free food out of the mail, you know, extra, you know. Like we used to go, we used to go for the drinks there, you know. When the white people carry us out, they would pay us, you know, carry us out in different places. We used to just buy beer and wine first, you know what I said.
